result.instructions: Tools for Shiftbase, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Shiftbase data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run shiftbase_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run shiftbase_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run shiftbase_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. shiftbase_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: shiftbase_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: The Shiftbase account this API key belongs to: company, country, time zone, working-day start/end, plan facts. GET /accounts.

tools.name: shiftbase_list_users
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: List employees (users) with their teams and departments, contact details, employee number, start/end dates and plus-min hours balance. Use it to map user ids in schedules, timesheets and absences to names. Identity, bank and birth data are never returned. GET /users.

active.description: true = only active employees, false = only inactive. Default: both.

limit.description: Results per page, 1-200 (default 50). The reply's total and next_offset show what is left.

offset.description: Index of the first result; pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: shiftbase_get_user
tools.title: Get employee
tools.description: One employee by user id or email address, with teams and departments. GET /users/{identifier}.

tools.name: shiftbase_list_departments
tools.title: List departments
tools.description: List departments (sites/branches that own teams, shifts and schedules) with address and timesheet/clocking settings. GET /departments.

limit.description: Results per page, 1-200 (default 50). The reply's total and next_offset show what is left.

offset.description: Index of the first result; pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: shiftbase_list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: List teams (the rows of the schedule within a department), optionally for one department. GET /teams.

limit.description: Results per page, 1-200 (default 50). The reply's total and next_offset show what is left.

offset.description: Index of the first result; pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: shiftbase_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List active locations (addresses that group departments). GET /locations.

limit.description: Results per page, 1-200 (default 50). The reply's total and next_offset show what is left.

offset.description: Index of the first result; pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: shiftbase_list_shift_types
tools.title: List shift types
tools.description: List shift types (the templates a scheduled shift uses: name, short name, default start/end time and break), optionally for one department. Their ids are the shift_id for shiftbase_create_roster. GET /shifts.

department_id.description: Only shift types of this department.

limit.description: Results per page, 1-200 (default 50). The reply's total and next_offset show what is left.

offset.description: Index of the first result; pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: shiftbase_list_rosters
tools.title: List scheduled shifts
tools.description: List the schedule (rosters = shifts assigned to employees) for a date range of at most 62 days: date, start/end time, break, employee, team, shift type, department, published state, hours and cost. Each item's occurrence_id identifies it for shiftbase_get_roster and shiftbase_update_roster. GET /rosters.

max_date.description: Last date (yyyy-mm-dd), at most 62 days after min_date.

limit.description: Results per page, 1-200 (default 50). The reply's total and next_offset show what is left.

offset.description: Index of the first result; pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: shiftbase_get_roster
tools.title: Get scheduled shift
tools.description: One scheduled shift by its occurrence_id, with the employee, shift type, team and who created/changed it. GET /rosters/{occurrenceId}.

occurrence_id.description: The occurrence_id from shiftbase_list_rosters: "<roster id>" or, for a recurring shift, "<roster id>:<yyyy-mm-dd>".

tools.name: shiftbase_list_open_shifts
tools.title: List open shifts
tools.description: List open (unassigned) shifts that employees can pick up, for a date range of at most 62 days (default: today). Needs the Basic plan or higher. GET /open_shifts.

min_date.description: First date (yyyy-mm-dd). Give both dates or neither (= today).

department_id.description: Only open shifts in this department.

user_id.description: Only open shifts this employee can take.

limit.description: Results per page, 1-200 (default 50). The reply's total and next_offset show what is left.

offset.description: Index of the first result; pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: shiftbase_get_availability
tools.title: Get employee availability
tools.description: Employee availability (available / unavailable, all day or from a time) for a date range of at most 62 days, from Shiftbase's availability report. Needs the Basic plan and the "View reports" permission. POST /reports/availability (export json; reads only).

to.description: Last date (yyyy-mm-dd), at most 62 days after from.

limit.description: Results per page, 1-200 (default 50). The reply's total and next_offset show what is left.

offset.description: Index of the first result; pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: shiftbase_list_timesheets
tools.title: List timesheets
tools.description: List timesheets (worked hours: clock in/out, breaks, total, status Approved/Declined/Pending, wage and surcharges) for a date range of at most 62 days. GET /timesheets.

max_date.description: Last date (yyyy-mm-dd), at most 62 days after min_date.

limit.description: Results per page, 1-200 (default 50). The reply's total and next_offset show what is left.

offset.description: Index of the first result; pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: shiftbase_get_timesheet
tools.title: Get timesheet
tools.description: One timesheet by id, with its clocked breaks. GET /timesheets/{timesheetId}.

tools.name: shiftbase_list_clocked_in
tools.title: List clocked-in employees
tools.description: Who is clocked in right now: employee, since when, their scheduled shift, team, department and location. GET /timesheets/clock.

limit.description: Results per page, 1-200 (default 50). The reply's total and next_offset show what is left.

offset.description: Index of the first result; pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: shiftbase_list_absences
tools.title: List absences
tools.description: List absences (leave, sick leave, other time off) overlapping a date range of at most 366 days: employee, absence type, start/end date, hours or days, status Approved/Declined/Pending and who reviewed it. Needs the Basic plan. GET /absentees.

max_date.description: Last date (yyyy-mm-dd), at most 366 days after min_date.

status.description: Only absences with this status (Pending = requests waiting for review).

absence_type_ids.description: Only these absence types (ids from shiftbase_list_absence_types).

only_open_ended.description: Only open-ended absences (no end date yet, e.g. long-term sick leave).

include.description: Add related data: the per-day breakdown, the employee or the absence type.

limit.description: Results per page, 1-200 (default 50). The reply's total and next_offset show what is left.

offset.description: Index of the first result; pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: shiftbase_get_absence
tools.title: Get absence
tools.description: One absence by id, with the per-day hours and who reviewed it. GET /absentees/{absenteeId}.

tools.name: shiftbase_list_absence_types
tools.title: List absence types
tools.description: List absence types (e.g. Holiday, Sick, Unpaid leave): name, unit (hours or days), whether it costs leave hours, colour. Their ids are the absence_type_id for absences. GET /absentee_options.

limit.description: Results per page, 1-200 (default 50). The reply's total and next_offset show what is left.

offset.description: Index of the first result; pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: shiftbase_get_expected_absence_hours
tools.title: Get expected absence hours
tools.description: How many hours an absence would cost for an employee, per day and in total (from the schedule or the contract, per the absence policy), for a period of at most 366 days. Changes nothing. POST /absentees/expected.

tools.name: shiftbase_create_roster
tools.title: Schedule a shift
tools.description: WRITE: put one employee on the schedule for one date (a single, non-recurring shift) in a team, with a shift type, start/end time and break. The employee is notified only when notify is true. POST /rosters.

end_time.description: End, 24-hour hh:mm (e.g. 17:30); earlier than start = ends the next day.

tools.name: shiftbase_update_roster
tools.title: Change a scheduled shift
tools.description: WRITE: change a scheduled shift: move it to another date, time, employee, team or shift type, or change its break or note. Reads the shift first and sends it back with your changes. For a recurring shift, scope says what changes: "occurrence" (this date only), "sequence" (this date and all later ones) or "original" (the whole series; also the right scope for a non-recurring shift). PUT /rosters/{occurrenceId}/{scope}.

scope.description: "original" for a non-recurring shift; see the description for recurring ones.

department_id.description: New department (when moving to a team of another department).

tools.name: shiftbase_request_absence
tools.title: Request an absence
tools.description: WRITE: add an absence (leave/time-off request) for an employee. By default it is a Pending request for a manager to review; status Approved books it directly (needs the approve-absence permission). The hours per day come from Shiftbase's own expected-hours calculation (the same as shiftbase_get_expected_absence_hours). Needs the Basic plan. POST /absentees.

end_date.description: Last day (yyyy-mm-dd), at most 366 days after start_date.

status.description: Pending (default) = a request to review; Approved = book it directly.

tools.name: shiftbase_review_absence
tools.title: Approve or decline an absence
tools.description: WRITE: approve or decline an absence request. Reads the absence first and sends it back unchanged except for the status (needs the approve-absence permission). PUT /absentees/{absenteeId}.

absence_id.description: Absence (absentee) id, e.g. from shiftbase_list_absences with status Pending.
